title: [BUG] time is off
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X] Anthropic API
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.45 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS
- Terminal:  gnome-term (xterm-256color)

## Bug Description
Claude doesn't know what time it is. At ~5:50 PM CDT it timestamped a file (i.e., noted in contents) as 7:14 PM. I asked claude code what time it is and it confirmed that it thought the time was 7:14 PM CDT. I advised it to use the `date` command to get the time going forward

## Steps to Reproduce
1. ask claude code what time it is
2. get the incorrect time back

## Expected Behavior
expected the correct time to be given

## Actual Behavior
got the incorrect time

## Additional Context
